notes.title: New and probaby last little update for this Playtest
notes.content:
Probably the last little update for this playtest:

- New advanced help informations. Because the game can be complex to get into. There is now an advanced combat guide available at any time during battle. With all the explanations needed to understand how the battles work and how to win.
- Tutorial has been once again improved a little bit here and there.
- The new Scores Counter UI can now show the corresponding Unit on the battlefield when you hover its score.
- Rework of the Kodama "Morph". Before it was morphing into a random ennemy Kodama. Now it's morphing into the closest allied Kodama. This change brings a lot more synergies and tactical choices.

Thanks to everyone who tried the Playtest!

notes.title: Little update with added damage graphs
notes.content:
New little update where we added a damage report UI, for both your team and the AI's team, that shows how much damages Kodamas dealt and tanked each round. It also helps to quickly see wich unit is attacking or defending during a fight.

Between this new indicator and the one from the previous update, it's now much easier to understand what's going on in your board and during a fight.

notes.title: Little game comprehension update
notes.content:
This little update focuses on making the game more easy to understand for new players and show them how to play the game correctly.
- Added a new indicator summarising each unit that will attack or defend in the current round, and in the following rounds (for allies and ennemy units). It's a big new indicator that will help new players.It will also be very helpful in the harder difficulty levels (not available in the playtest) where you really need to a solid board management.
- A small helper that will appear sometimes when you haven't won a run yet and will help ew players find the right way to play the game.

notes.title: The game changes name, it is now Kodama Battles!
notes.content:
This new name reflects more what the game is about. It's not a "perfect name" because "Battle" is maybe too strong of a word for Kodamas who are supposed to be mainly peaceful. Another word like "Squabble" or something similar would be more appropriate. But for marketing and comprehension purposes we chose this one, hopefully you like it!

The name change is reflected in the current playtest version of the game. Except for the game files that will keep the old name for the duration of the playtest (if we change it everyone looses its save files).

We also slipped two accessiblity improvements to this Playtest update:
- There are now little stars indicators that show easily the star level of each Kodama.
- Placing/moving untits on the board didn't work really well sometimes. It's not much more reliable and smooth.

notes.title: Little cinematic/readability update
notes.content:
- To improve readability/enjoyment of the Battles, we added new camera angles and optimized the angles of the Spirits relative to the current viewpoint.
- New dynamic change of the Team size/reroll indicator's position to avoid a Spirit blocking its view.
- Added back the Spirits walking around in the Main Menu screen (when a Spirit is unlocked you will see it walking around there). And added a new camera angle to the Mainmenu.

notes.title: QOL update
notes.content:
Little update with a few quality of life features:
- It's now possible to drag Spirits from the shop to spawn them. So you can now eiher click or drag to spawn a Spirit (some people have different preferences).
- Before you could only choose between two speeds for battles and it could be too slow sometimes. Now there is a lot more granularity and you can go from very slow to very fast battle speed.
- "Tiles Movements" indicators were not very visible before and often missed, leading to unexpected movements of Spirits that surprised players. It's not much more visible, harder to miss and be surprised.
- And a bug fix of a weird behavior happening when exiting the tutorial and starting a run (the shop was filled with only one Spirit the first round of the new run, it didn't always happen though).
